name: Gas-averaged graviton propagator of a Poisson brane gas has ghosts (theorem)
target: Positivity of the Kallen-Lehmann representation of the averaged propagator of a Poisson gas of branes
result: For the linear-factor gas, E[1/(zF(z))]=exp(-phi(z))/z has no standard positive Stieltjes/Kallen-Lehmann representation when the intensity is nonzero. If lambda<=1 almost everywhere, it has the negative-measure representation proved in the paper. The converse sign criterion and the finite-four-dimensional-tadpole tradeoff use the stated continuity and local Holder hypotheses. A total massive-weight formula presupposes existence of a finite signed measure; general intensities can instead give nonintegrable boundary densities or essential singularities.
